name: Benchmark Iron Lantern 03
prompt: Create a single medieval hanging lantern 3D prop for Blender. The object has a rectangular black iron cage with four vertical corner posts, four clear glass windows around a small yellow candle flame, a pointed metal cap on top and a curved metal carrying handle. The bottom is a compact iron tray. Make the frame dark metal with translucent amber glass and a small orange-yellow glowing light inside. It should read as one lantern that a person can carry, not architecture or a house. Save the editable Blender project and render, then open the new model in Blender.
